title: Create the demo log file
prompt: Create a file named DROVER_CHAIN_DEMO.md at the repository root containing exactly one line: 'step 1 done'. Commit it with the message 'drover: step 1'. When finished, output exactly this string on its own line: TICKET_COMPLETE

title: Append to the demo log file
prompt: Append a new line to DROVER_CHAIN_DEMO.md at the repository root reading 'step 2 done'. Commit it with the message 'drover: step 2'. When finished, output exactly this string on its own line: TICKET_COMPLETE

title: Finish the demo log file
prompt: Append a final line to DROVER_CHAIN_DEMO.md at the repository root reading 'step 3 done — chain complete'. Commit it with the message 'drover: step 3'. When finished, output exactly this string on its own line: TICKET_COMPLETE
